facts.statement: Snarf was throwing himself a party in late November 2009 that players could help with; the article was posted about 3 days and 5 hours before capture.
facts.quote: Snarf is throwing himself a party, and you can help him make it happen!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?: Meet Snarf
article_summaries.summary: A SOE news post introducing Snarf, a troll who is on vacation and wandering Free Realms, and throwing himself a party that players can help with. It gives Snarf's location as the intersection of the roads north of Merry Vale and west of Highroad Junction, beside an outdoor picnic area near the inn. The article gives no quest steps, rewards or party details.
